title: fix(desktop): keep Kaipu in the Dock and Cmd+Tab after recording and camera toggles
body:
## What

On macOS, Kaipu dropped out of the Dock and ⌘-Tab after the first recording of a session and after every camera toggle. The app kept working; only toggling **Show in Dock & app switcher** off and on brought it back. Reported on desktop 0.14.1.

## Why

Two defects together (full chain in ADR 0029):

1. `control-bar-window.ts` and `camera-bubble-window.ts` called `setVisibleOnAllWorkspaces(true, { visibleOnFullScreen: true })` without `skipTransformProcessType`. Electron 39 then runs `app.dock.hide()` (`Browser::DockHide` → `TransformProcessType(kProcessTransformToUIElementApplication)`) to get a plain window over a full-screen app. That removes the Dock icon and the ⌘-Tab entry.
2. Since #255 (2026-10-07, "apply the macOS activation policy only on an actual transition") the policy setter skips any call that matches its cache. The cache said `regular` the whole time, so `forceRegularPolicy()` at start, `applyDockPolicy()` at stop, after the camera toggle and from `⌘⌃O` were all no-ops. Before that fix the bug was masked by accident: `app.dock.show()` ran under a second before the bar was created, and Electron ignores a `DockHide` that lands within a second of a `DockShow`.

## Fix

- Both recording panels are `type: "panel"` on macOS and pass `skipTransformProcessType: true` — the recipe the capture panel, overlays and toast already use.
- The setter treats a call as unchanged only when its cache **and** `app.dock.isVisible()` (Electron reads the real `NSRunningApplication.activationPolicy`) agree. A Dock dropped behind its back is restored at the next re-assertion; a matching re-assertion still touches no AppKit state, so the blur fix stays intact.

## Docs

- ADR 0029 — floating windows never change the activation policy, and the policy setter checks AppKit before skipping (with reopen conditions).
- Backlog page `bug-app-lost-from-app-switcher` (🟢 Ready to validate) with owner validation steps; follow-up note on `bug-main-window-hides-on-blur`; both pages added to the sidebar.

## Verification

- New tests: `floating-window-policy.test.ts`, plus cases in `settings-store.test.ts` and `recording-hub.test.ts`. All five fail on the previous sources and pass now.
- Desktop suite: 258 files, 2239 tests green. `check-types`, `oxlint`, `oxfmt` clean on touched files. Docs site builds.

## Owner QA (packaged build)

1. Record once and stop; repeat with the camera on/off. Kaipu stays in ⌘-Tab and the Dock.
2. Put another app in full screen and record it: the bar and bubble float over it, drag, and the bar's buttons respond without pulling the main window forward. This is the one behaviour I could not verify from here — the panels are now non-activating `NSPanel`s.
3. With the Dock setting off: record and stop; the app stays menu-bar only.
4. `⌘⌃O` brings the main window forward in every state above.
